thread:
claire (AE): Heads-up  AuroraPay wants to lock a Q3 commit. Traffic: ~560 rps peak, avg ~17k tokens/session, sustained 75m market window. They asked for a concrete reserved GPU recommendation + burst credits, prewarm plan, and a short ops/runbook snippet for the contract. Also legal wants a market-hours SLA and an automated fallback plan.

josh (Sales Eng): Quick clarifying q: is 560 rps sustained or bursty within the 75m?

claire (AE): They said sustained during the window, with short 10-15m spikes before and after. Require p50 < 250ms and 99.95% for the window.

meera (Solutions): Important: model footprint + KV-state. If they accept quantized variant we can reduce GPU count ~2.3x. Recommend persistent KV cache + selective prefix warm. Prewarm schedule should align with the 75m window.

gareth (SRE): Ballpark compute thought: with caching and batching, conservative rec is reserve 7 GPUs (quantized) as baseline, 2 burst GPUs prewarmed; autoscale cap 9. Draft ops snippet below. We must run perf on their model for final numbers.

priya (Infra): Note: they want Private VPC + KMS. Private AZ spread for SLA will limit burst into shared pool. Lead time for infra provisioning + KMS handshake ~2-3 weeks.

meera (Solutions): Pricing ask from procurement: show two scenarios (quantized vs fp16) with monthly baseline + burst credit bucket and a worst-case overage (4 spike events/month). Use 2.5x efficiency for quantized as conservative.

josh (Sales Eng): They want an amortized $/token too for CFO. Can we give a quick placeholder?

gareth (SRE): Placeholder: compute hours * $/gpu-hr -> token amortization after we bench. For now, include a conservative $/token that assumes 30% warmup billing overhead.

meera (Solutions): Draft autoscale snippet for ops runbook (for handoff):
```
autoscale_policy:
  baseline_replicas: 7
  min_replicas: 4
  burst_replicas: 2
  burst_window_sec: 900  # 15min burst slots
  kv_cache:
    enabled: true
    persistence: true
    ttl_hours: 12
  prewarm_schedule:
    - cron: "15 12 * * 1-5"  # prewarm 60-75m before market open
      replicas: 9
  degrade_policy:
    queue_depth_threshold: 200
    sustained_sec: 60
    fallback_model: "aurora-7b-quant"
```
Callouts: (1) prewarm must include KMS smoke test; abort if decrypt fails, (2) warm only high-frequency prefixes to limit billing.

priya (Infra): Adding infra note: when Private + AZ-spread requested, reserve GPUs across two AZs and add +1 replica for failover to meet SLA. This changes baseline from 7 -> 8 if they insist on 99.95.

josh (Sales Eng): Action items: (1) gareth to run perf bench on their model for 8k/17k contexts by EOD tomorrow if they provide container; (2) meera to draft cost table (quantized vs fp16) + amortized $/token and include warmup line item; (3) priya to list lead times and KMS checklist for handoff; (4) claire to confirm Private vs Dedicated with customer.

ops-bot: Reminder  security questionnaire outstanding items: KMS proof, vendor SOC2, encryption-in-transit report.

gareth (SRE): If container not provided in time, we'll recommend conservative reserve 9 quantized GPUs + 3 burst GPUs and scale down after perf. Also suggest automated canary: send 5% traffic to new revision for 10min, monitor p50/p99 and queue then ramp.

claire (AE): I'll ping AuroraPay for artifacts and confirm Private requirement. Will follow up in-thread after gareth posts bench. Thanks team :thumbsup:
